description: All buildings in the Netherlands from the BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen), harmonized to the EU INSPIRE Buildings schema. Contains 24.2 million building footprint polygons with construction dates and BAG identifiers. Includes both current and historical versions — records with endLifespanVersion = null are the current version. Published by Kadaster via PDOK.

links.title: Column definitions: D2.8.III.2 INSPIRE Data Specification on Buildings – Technical Guidelines v3.0

table:columns.name: OGC_FID
table:columns.description: Technical: sequential feature id added by the OGR/GDAL conversion.

table:columns.name: gml_id
table:columns.description: Technical XML id of the feature in the source INSPIRE GML (gml:id); unique within the delivered file.

table:columns.name: beginLifespanVersion
table:columns.description: Date and time at which this version of the building was inserted or changed in the spatial data set (BU beginLifespanVersion).

table:columns.name: anyPoint
table:columns.description: A date and time of any point of the event, between its beginning and its end (BU DateOfEvent.anyPoint); here from dateOfConstruction/dateOfDemolition.

table:columns.name: endLifespanVersion
table:columns.description: Date and time at which this version of the building was superseded or retired in the spatial data set (BU endLifespanVersion).

table:columns.name: localId
table:columns.description: Local identifier assigned by the data provider; unique within the namespace (INSPIRE Identifier.localId, GCM).

table:columns.name: namespace
table:columns.description: Namespace uniquely identifying the data source of the spatial object (INSPIRE Identifier.namespace, GCM).

table:columns.name: referenceGeometry
table:columns.description: Flag marking the geometry to be taken into account by view services, for portrayal (BuildingGeometry2D.referenceGeometry, INSPIRE BU spec).

table:columns.name: horizontalGeometryEstimatedAccuracy
table:columns.description: Estimated absolute positional accuracy of the (X,Y) coordinates of the building geometry, in the INSPIRE CRS; metres (BU spec).

table:columns.name: verticalGeometryEstimatedAccuracy
table:columns.description: Estimated absolute positional accuracy of the Z coordinates of the building geometry, in the INSPIRE CRS; metres (BU spec).

table:columns.name: end
table:columns.description: Date and time when the event ended (BU DateOfEvent.end); flattened from a building DateOfEvent such as dateOfConstruction or dateOfDemolition.

table:columns.name: beginning
table:columns.description: Date and time when the event begun (BU DateOfEvent.beginning); flattened from a building DateOfEvent such as dateOfConstruction or dateOfDemolition.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).
